sys_script_include.description: Server-side helper for the unauthenticated Experience Portal. Provides submitCase(payload) for anonymous case submission and lookupCase(number) for anonymous status lookup. Enforces strict field whitelisting per AAP Section 0.7.4: submission accepts only subject, type, description, requester_name, requester_email and forces status=Draft regardless of payload; lookup returns only status, subject, opened_date and never exposes internal fields. submitCase validates its input before inserting - subject, description and requester_name are required and must not exceed 255/4000/100 characters (an over-length value is refused with a named field error, never truncated), requester_email must look like an address when supplied and must not exceed 100 characters, type must be a live choice of x_casemgmt_case.type - an admission ceiling evaluated AFTER the insert bounds the unauthenticated write path (the inserted row is ranked among the same caller's rows inside a 60-second window under a total order of sys_created_on then sys_id, and a row at or beyond the global ceiling of 10, or at or beyond the per-requester ceiling of 4 counted over the rows sharing its normalised requester_email bucket, is deleted again and refused with throttled=true; ranking published rows rather than counting before the insert is what stops parallel callers all reading the same below-ceiling count and all being admitted), and an identical submission received inside a 90-second window is collapsed onto the surviving case (same five values, still Draft, same caller) so a retry or a simultaneous double-post yields one case rather than two - the duplicate row is deleted and its case number is consumed, leaving a gap in the CASE sequence; submitCase returns {number} on success, {error, fields} when validation refuses the payload, {error, throttled} when the admission ceiling refuses it, or {error} when the insert fails; lookupCase normalises and strictly validates the supplied number against ^CASE[0-9]{7}$ before any query, throttles the read path per session in the GlideSession client-data store, and warns under the stable marker X_CASEMGMT_PORTAL_LOOKUP_ABUSE| when a session crosses the soft miss threshold or is throttled; it returns the whitelisted record on match, {throttled} when the session is over its ceiling (the REST operation answers HTTP 429), or null on no-match - which a malformed, empty or absent number produces identically and without a query (the calling scripted REST endpoint translates null into the HTTP 404 not-found response whose verbatim body is specified by AAP Section 0.7.4). The hit-versus-miss distinction is inherent to the single-factor number-only lookup the AAP mandates and is compensated rather than removed; the residual risk is recorded in docs/portal-pages.md. Replaces the persistence and lookup roles of ArkCase SaveCaseService and GetCaseByNumberService for the portal slice. Contains zero gs.eventQueue() calls per the email-disabled constraint and zero hardcoded sys_id reference literals.
sys_script_include.name: CasePortalService
